name: nap-declarations
description: Windows desktop app for the Bulgarian annual tax declaration under Art. 50 of the Personal Income Tax Act (Декларация по чл. 50 от ЗДДФЛ): import of statements from investment intermediaries and management of the declarations (download, draft, view, archive) through the NRA (НАП) portal.

scripts.test: node --test test/parser.test.js test/import.test.js test/portaldraft.test.js test/xslt.test.js test/napview.test.js test/legacy.test.js
